title: geranium pyrenaicum subsp. lusitanicum
intro: Geranium pyrenaicum subsp. lusitanicum, commonly known as Lusitanian Geranium, is a plant species within the Geranium genus, native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Lusitanian Geranium include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and estrogenic properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
